title: Frontend Engineer (React)
description: Focuses on React components, lifecycle, hooks, state management, and performance.

questions.text: What is the purpose of React.Profiler and how do you use it to identify bottlenecks?
How does React Virtual DOM work under the hood, and what are the main benefits?
Can you explain the concept of Higher-Order Components (HOC) and how they compare to custom hooks?
Explain the difference between Controlled and Uncontrolled inputs in React form management.
What are React Portals and when would you use them for modal overlays or dialog boxes?

title: Frontend Proctored (React)
description: Live video proctored interview assessing advanced React architecture, state management, and performance.

questions.text: How do you structure a large scale React application for maintainability?
What are the main differences between custom hooks and the render props pattern?
Explain the differences between client-side rendering (CSR) and static site generation (SSG) in React.
Can you walk me through how you would implement server-side rendering in a React application?
How would you handle theme switching dynamically using CSS variables and React Context API?

title: Backend Engineer (Node/Express)
description: Covers event loop, asynchronous design patterns, RESTful design, and security.

questions.text: Explain how middleware execution order and flow control works in Express.js.
What is your approach to handling transactions and concurrent updates in databases like MongoDB or PostgreSQL?
How do you analyze a heap dump to debug memory leaks in a running Node.js process?
How does JWT authentication work, and how do you handle token revocation?
Describe a scenario where you would use Streams in Node.js instead of standard file system buffer methods.

title: HR & Behavioral Round
description: General HR behavioral questions assessing cultural fit, conflict resolution, and leadership.

questions.text: Tell me about a time when you had a conflict with a teammate or manager. How did you resolve it?
What is your preference: working in a highly collaborative team or independently, and why?
How do you proactively stay updated with the latest technological developments and frameworks?
Why do you want to join our company, and where do you see your career heading in the next 3 to 5 years?
What is your greatest technical achievement, and what did you learn from the process?

title: System Architect
description: Advanced systems architecture, scaling databases, caching strategy, microservices, and high-availability designs.

questions.text: Describe your approach to database sharding vs replication. When would you use one over the other?
How do you design a global content delivery caching layer, and how do you handle cache invalidation at scale?
Explain the CAP theorem. In what scenarios would you choose AP (Availability-Partition) over CP (Consistency-Partition)?
Explain how Consistent Hashing works and why it is useful in distributed caching or database sharding.
How would you architect a real-time collaborative document editor like Google Docs?

title: HR Interview
description: General behavioral and cultural fit questions for any role.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you had to learn a completely new skill very quickly.
Why are you leaving your current role?
Tell me about a time you handled a difficult situation with a coworker.
How do you manage professional pressure and tight production deadlines?
Why do you believe you are the best fit for this specific position?

title: Java
description: Technical questions covering core Java, JVM, multithreading, and OOP.

questions.text: What is the Java Reflection API and in what scenarios would you use it?
Explain the difference between JDK, JRE, and JVM.
Explain the difference between final, finally, and finalize keywords in Java.
Explain the concept of multithreading in Java and how to create a thread.
What are the main differences between HashMap and ConcurrentHashMap?

title: C Programming
description: Core concepts in C including pointers, memory management, and data structures.

questions.text: What is the static keyword used for in C variables and functions?
Explain the difference between malloc() and calloc().
What is a pointer to a pointer in C?
Describe how memory leaks occur in C and how to prevent them.
What is the purpose of the volatile keyword?

title: Python
description: Python fundamentals, data structures, decorators, and memory management.

questions.text: Explain the difference between a list and a tuple in Python.
How do decorators work in Python?
What is the difference between *args and **kwargs in Python function definitions?
Explain how exception handling works with try-except-finally blocks.
How do generators work in Python and why are they memory efficient?

title: HTML
description: HTML5 features, semantics, accessibility, and DOM structure.

questions.text: What are semantic HTML elements and why are they important?
Explain the difference between block and inline elements.
Explain the difference between local storage, session storage, and cookies.
How do you use meta tags for SEO and responsive display viewport configuration?
Explain the purpose of SVG and Canvas in HTML5.

title: CSS
description: CSS Box Model, layout models (Flexbox/Grid), animations, and responsive design.

questions.text: How do you implement CSS animations and transition keyframes?
Explain the CSS Box Model.
Explain the concept of z-index and stacking contexts in CSS.
What is a media query and how do you write responsive breakpoints?
What is the difference between Flexbox and CSS Grid?

title: JavaScript
description: Core JS concepts: closures, promises, event loop, and ES6+ features.

questions.text: What is the difference between map, filter, and reduce array methods?
What is event bubbling and how can you stop it?
Explain the difference between let, const, and var.
How does the event loop handle asynchronous operations?
What is prototype-based inheritance in JavaScript?

title: Web Development
description: General web architecture, REST APIs, HTTP protocols, and security.

questions.text: Explain how you would optimize a website for better performance.
Explain the difference between HTTP and HTTPS.
What is DOM and how does browser render HTML pages?
How does client-side caching work using ETag and Cache-Control headers?
What happens when you type a URL into a browser and press enter?

title: Authentication
description: OAuth, JWTs, session management, and securing web applications.

questions.text: Explain how JSON Web Tokens (JWT) work.
What is the difference between authentication and authorization?
What is single sign-on (SSO) and how does it work?
Explain the difference between OAuth2 and SAML.
How do you securely store passwords in a database?
